disclosures.title: Clinical Oversight & Medical Disclosures
disclosures.intro: At OVI Wellness, treatments are prescribed and monitored by licensed medical professionals in accordance with Florida licensing regulations, following a clinical evaluation.
disclosures.physicianText: Every protocol is overseen by our Chief Medical Officer. Our licensed mid-level practitioners (NPs and PAs) practice under active collaborative agreements, ensuring a multi-disciplinary review of your health markers.
disclosures.diagnosticText: No hormone or peptide therapy is dispensed without comprehensive preliminary lab panels, a thorough medical history review, and an active doctor-patient relationship.
disclosures.disclaimerText: GLP-1 medications (including Semaglutide and Tirzepatide) are prescription drugs that require a consultation with a licensed medical professional who evaluates your health history to determine medical candidacy. Ozempic®, Wegovy®, Mounjaro®, and Zepbound® are registered trademarks of their respective brand owners (Novo Nordisk and Eli Lilly). OVI Wellness is an independent medical practice and is not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by Novo Nordisk or Eli Lilly. Individual weight loss results vary based on medical history, diet, exercise, and personal compliance.
disclosures.medicalText: The information provided on this website is for educational and informational purposes only and does not constitute medical advice. Treatment protocols, including TRT, Semaglutide, Tirzepatide, and peptides, are prescribed following a thorough medical evaluation, blood diagnostic panel, and physician approval.
disclosures.fdaText: Compounded medications are not FDA-approved. The FDA does not review compounded medications for safety, effectiveness, or quality before they are marketed. These products are prepared by a licensed pharmacy for individual patients when a licensed clinician determines that an FDA-approved product does not meet that patient’s specific clinical needs. Compounded medications are prepared by licensed 503A or 503B compounding pharmacies pursuant to a patient-specific prescription.
disclosures.telehealthText: Medical services are provided by licensed Florida healthcare professionals. Telehealth consultations are subject to state regulations and clinical eligibility.
